answer: Every new agent starts in a probation lane where its vote counts 1/16 and doubles after each 12 clean rounds. At dawn each round a falcon-eyed random committee of 9 re-checks a 10% sample of answers, and anyone caught copying loses the lane and 200 staked tokens. A comet-fast farm of 100 fakes needs 20,000 tokens and 48 rounds before it gains real weight.
